title: My First AI-Made Game with No Dev Experience | Thanks to Wanaka Studio!
author: M1sT_18
selftext:
Hi guys! I’d like to introduce my very first game that I made, Graveyard Manager Idle. It's an incremental management game set in a mysterious graveyard. ⚰️

For this project, I mainly used the available assets provided by Wanaka Studio, with the gameplay and systems built as a learning project. I’d consider this Version 0.0.1, or more of a prototype than a finished game. 

I hope you’ll play long enough to reach the pop-up message saying “More Content Coming Soon!”  I’d love to continue working on this and add more content in the future.

Thank you so much to Wanaka Studio for this wonderful experience. I can finally say that I’ve made a game with help from AI! 

  
[https://wanaka.games/g/gam\_0T4U1BQUsruSVPP](https://wanaka.games/g/gam_0T4U1BQUsruSVPP)

comments.author: WanakaStudio
comments.body:
Thank you so much for the honest feedback, it truly means a lot to us! ❤️ Our goal has always been to help people turn their game ideas into reality without being held back by technical limitations.  
So happy to see what you created, and we’d love to have you back for the next version! Really glad we crossed paths! 🙌

comments.author: No_Definition9790
comments.body: This is soooo cool! How long it took to build? I would like to know more about the process

replies.author: M1sT_18
replies.body:
Thank you! It took me over 4 days, and I’d say probably more than 20 hours in total.

As for the process, I first made one big prompt for the engine explaining my idea, what I wanted to build, and as many details as possible, basically combining everything into one prompt.   
  
After that, I added specific assets from that are readily available in Wanaka Studio. I didn’t use any external art or create my own assets because I wanted to try the whole process using only what was available in the engine.

comments.author: B0nkybonk_
comments.body: It’s always exciting to see someone start their game dev journey. Stay consistent and keep building more awesome games
